name: Ichijou Arashi
source:
A new fighter who was brainwashed to join the evil organization. She is a coworker and roommate of Akuno Masayoshi.
　
Because she has been brainwashed, she does not speak much, buts he is a cool-headed and a quick-tempered fighter.

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
